svg.aria-label: Bilingual plots from one run: 20 warmups and 120 measurements/configuration, CPU, single-thread. Left: empirical single-image call times. Right: batch size divided by median duration. ONNX invocation overhead is included; input loading, HTTP and queueing are outside the boundary.
